topic: Price Elasticity Analysis - Small Business Segment

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I need basic internet for credit card processing and some customer wifi. Budget is tight - what's your cheapest option?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I understand budget is important for small businesses. Our Small Business Essential plan is $89 monthly for 100 Mbps - perfect for payment processing and guest wifi without overpaying for features you don't need.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's reasonable. Other companies quoted $150-200. What's included at that price?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Everything you need - reliable internet, basic router, 24/7 support, and no setup fees. We keep it simple and affordable for businesses like yours.
